children: ACI Worldwide said Solaris has gone live on ACI Connetic for SEPA Instant payments, completing phase one of Solaris’ payments modernization and consolidating its instant payments infrastructure on ACI’s cloud-native platform.
Validates ACI’s platform with a regulated BaaS bank, supporting future volume and upsell.
Drives recurring processing and fraud services usage as instant becomes mandatory baseline.
Signals execution toward broader Solaris migration that could expand ACI footprint.
Simplifies scaling and speeds feature rollout, aiding ACI’s competitive positioning.
If Solaris scales regionally, ACI could capture higher volumes over time.

This extends ACI’s strategy to anchor instant payments workloads on its Connetic platform with regulated institutions. A larger catalyst would be disclosed metrics—volumes, contract scope, or additional migrations—showing material revenue impact.
